inputs.modified_text:
Folks, we are watching a direct assault on the foundations of our society. President John Mahama wants to talk about upholding the rule of law and hiding behind institutional rhetoric, claiming the rules of our system are tied to our cultural ethos and collective agreement, but let’s look at what is really happening to our time-tested laws and public order. 

The radical left has the absolute audacity to attack the rule of law itself, claiming that systemic inequality is baked into our institutions and demanding that we tear down the legal frameworks that maintain public order. They want to trash our constitutional oath—an oath that President John Mahama correctly took to uphold—just to advance their progressive agenda under the guise of global human rights. They are openly calling to radically reform our institutions to center labor and dismantle the legal structures that keep our country stable. 

This is the inevitable result when progressive agitators undermine authority and personal responsibility. Instead of respecting the laws that protect our nation, they are trying to replace our legal frameworks with chaos and smoke and mirrors for their reckless ideology. We must stand firm for our traditions, honor our oaths, and reject those who want to destroy the rule of law for their own radical purposes.
